predict.question: In this invented test, you train on four narrow examples that transfer to unfamiliar tasks 0% of the time and six broad ones that transfer 50%. What share transfers overall?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Range argues broad experience can help with transfer when problems are unfamiliar.
modelBoundary: The narrow portfolio transfers {A}%; mixed portfolio {B}%. The difference follows from assigned transfer rates and example weights.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Breadth’s advantage is an input here, not demonstrated evidence that generalists outperform specialists.
